title: eriogonum brevicaule var. ephedroides
intro: Eriogonum brevicaule var. ephedroides, commonly known as Ephedroid Sagebrush, is a species of flowering plant in the buckwheat family, Polygonaceae. This plant has been used to support respiratory health, including relief from congestion and coughs, and is also believed to have diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Eriogonum brevicaule var. ephedroides include bronchodilation, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant activities, which can help to alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as ephedrine, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although its ephedrine content is generally lower compared to other Ephedra species.
